overview.name: JPMorgan Managed Futures Plus ETF
overview.description: The fund seeks to achieve its investment objective by investing in and combining the benefits of two investment strategies: an active, managed futures strategy (Managed Futures Strategy) and a U.S. equity strategy (U.S. Equity Strategy). It is non-diversified.
